app_tagline: A bridge to public services for Andhra Pradesh citizens
disclaimer_banner: SevaSetu is not an official government service. Scheme details are being verified. Confirm with the office before applying.
unverified_banner: Scheme details are being verified. Confirm with the office before applying.
why_matters_desc: Every year, eligible citizens miss welfare support because complex rules and English paperwork stand in their way. SevaSetu turns government guidelines into a personal checklist and a pre-filled draft application in your own language in under 5 minutes.
why_matters_point1: Built for voice and low-literacy: speak in Telugu, Hindi, or English, or snap a photo of a notice.
why_matters_point2: Deterministic matching: rule-based eligibility calculation, never an AI guess.
why_matters_point3: Privacy by design: Aadhaar and ID numbers are masked and never stored.
